items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: we had a surprise guest, Babs Gonzales come up, just to sing with us.

ctx.x: Sam Dockery on piano and we had a surprise guest, Babs Gonzales come up, just to sing with us. But before this could come about, my lung collapsed on me. It frightened me, but stayed in the hospital for about seven or eight days and they inflated it again and I felt good, better than I did in months, because they put me on the proper medication. Do you know, I was tipping around there, sneaking cigarettes? The man had told me to stop smoking as early as 1973. But I didn't, so I paid the price.
Now after we played the gig, the gig was in November -- was it November?
